'''Dan Pratt''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 Rochester tournament (22 April)]] on 22 April 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit with inserts and Eloms]], according to R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d586">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-23-look-ma-no-notes-roche-ny-4-22d586/ look-ma-no-notes-roche-ny-4-22], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 23 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-23-look-ma-no-notes-roche-ny-4-22d586/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
